items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: We had Paul Benn and Jimmie Johnson was playing the bass in that band. And let's see, I can't think of some of those other guys. Oh yeah, I believe Lil' Kato was playing drums.

ctx.x: I think we, at the time I think we had Paul Benn. No, he was a boy from up the country there and he played around. We had Paul Benn and Jimmie Johnson was playing the bass in that band. And let's see, I can't think of some of those other guys. Oh yeah, I believe Lil' Kato was playing drums.
I think we had a big role in the band. After you finished the boat job, what did you do then?
